parameter_selection: fixed common RRF settings; no weight search or model fine-tuning
comparison: same cached INT8 BGE vectors, same text and filters; original 50 queries are development only
new_cases: Assistant-authored extra queries; not real-user blind judgments. Report separately from the original development set.
user_cases: Three actual user requirements, no known-positive labels. Inspect constraints and results, do not calculate accuracy from these cases.
limits: No historical-earliest guarantee, no objective niche threshold, no proof of theme absence from missing tags, no mobile performance guarantee.
